_meta.description: Per test arm, the median, lowest and 75th-percentile subscription plan tier, reading the plan categorical as an ordered scale (params.levels basic < plus < pro; params.ordered true would take the dictionary order). AGG_MEDIAN / AGG_MIN / AGG_PERCENTILE return the chosen level's dictionary index — a code, as AGG_MODE over a categorical does — chosen as R quantile(type = 1) over the level ranks, with no interpolation. A plan label params.levels does not list would be dropped and counted in the components' n_unlisted.
_meta.name: ordered_plan_tier_per_arm
